row.title: SITE-UPKEEP-1 built sites keep improving and keep history
row.body: Built sites get a weekly free deterministic pass plus at most two model passes per site tick, keep the last ten versions, and /s/<id>/history restores one (a restore is itself undoable). Rides the existing site tick; no new cron; model spend is the budget-wrapped env's.
